    adj = [0] * n
    forced = 0
    for u, v in instance['edges']:
        if u == v:
            forced |= 1 << u
        else:
            adj[u] |= 1 << v
            adj[v] |= 1 << u
    full = (1 << n) - 1
    allowed = full & ~forced

    # in its complement.  Its complement is a minimum vertex cover.

    best = 0

            vb = 1 << v

            x = keep

                eligible &= ~adj[b.bit_length() - 1]
            y = eligible

                b = y & -y

                z = eligible & ~adj[u] & ~b
                if z:
                    bestmask = keep | b | (z & -z)
                    best += 1
                    changed = True
                    break
            if changed:
                break
        if changed:
            continue

        # 2-for-3 exchange.
        selected = [v for v in range(n) if (bestmask >> v) & 1]
        outside = allowed & ~bestmask
        for ii, v in enumerate(selected):
            for w in selected[ii + 1:]:
                keep = bestmask ^ (1 << v) ^ (1 << w)
                eligible = outside
                x = keep
                while x:
                    b = x & -x
                    x ^= b
                    eligible &= ~adj[b.bit_length() - 1]

                        y ^= b2

                            bestmask = keep | b1 | b2 | (z & -z)
                            best += 1
                            changed = found = True
                            break
                if found:
                    break
            if changed:
                break
        if not changed:
            break

    deadline = time.process_time() + 1.30
    nodes = 0

    def color_sort(P):
        order = []
        bounds = []
        color = 0
        uncolored = P
        while uncolored:
            color += 1
            avail = uncolored
            while avail:
                x = avail

        run+=1
        avail=full; chosen=0
        # Randomized minimum-current-degree greedy; tune tie window
        alpha=rng.random()*2.5
        while avail:
            # choose low degree with random noise / restricted candidate list
            vals=[]; md=n+1
            xmask=avail
            while xmask:
                b=xmask&-xmask; x=b.bit_length()-1
                d=(adj[x]&avail).bit_count()
                if d<md: md=d
                vals.append((x,d)); xmask-=b
            # choose among vertices within random additive slack of min
            lim=md+alpha
            cand=[x for x,d in vals if d<=lim]
            x=rng.choice(cand)
            bit=1<<x; chosen|=bit
            avail &= ~(adj[x]|bit)
        # Improve by adding vertex or 1->2 exchange
        while True:

    for u, v in instance["edges"]:
        adj[u] |= 1 << v
        adj[v] |= 1 << u
        if u == v:
            loopmask |= 1 << u

    # A self-loop forces its vertex into every vertex cover.
    full = ((1 << n) - 1) & ~loopmask
    seed = (n * 345679 + len(instance["edges"]) * 987123
            + sum((u + 1) * (v + 11) for u, v in instance["edges"])) & 0xffffffff
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    start = time.process_time()
    deadline = start + 1.35

    # Randomized greedy independent sets provide a feasible incumbent.
    bestmask = 0
    for _ in range(80):
        available = full
        chosen = 0
        alpha = rng.random() * 2.0
        while available:
            vals = []
            min_degree = n + 1
            bits = available
            while bits:
                bit = bits & -bits
                x = bit.bit_length() - 1
                bits -= bit
                degree = (adj[x] & available).bit_count()
                min_degree = min(min_degree, degree)
                vals.append((x, degree))
            choices = [x for x, d in vals if d <= min_degree + alpha]
            x = rng.choice(choices)
            bit = 1 << x
            chosen |= bit
            available &= ~(adj[x] | bit)
        if chosen.bit_count() > bestmask.bit_count():
            bestmask = chosen

    best = bestmask.bit_count()
    nodes = 0
    timed_out = False

    def clique_cover_bound(P, graph):
        # Each clique in the original graph contributes at most one
        # vertex to an independent set.
        remaining = P
        count = 0
        while remaining:
            count += 1
            available = remaining
            while available:
                x = -1
                max_degree = -1
                bits = available
                while bits:
                    bit = bits & -bits
                    v = bit.bit_length() - 1
                    bits -= bit
                    degree = (graph[v] & remaining).bit_count()
                    if degree > max_degree:
                        max_degree = degree
                        x = v
                bit = 1 << x
                remaining &= ~bit
                available &= graph[x]
        return count

    def expand_folds(picked, history):
        for x, u, w, v in reversed(history):
            if (picked >> x) & 1:
                picked = (picked & ~(1 << x)) | (1 << u) | (1 << w)
            else:
                picked |= 1 << v
        return picked & full

    def search(P, depth, picked, graph, history):
        nonlocal best, bestmask, nodes, timed_out
        nodes += 1
        if (nodes & 31) == 0 and time.process_time() >= deadline:
            timed_out = True
            return

        # Exact reductions: isolated vertices, leaves, triangles, and
        # degree-two folding.
        while P:
            x = -1
            min_degree = n + 1
            bits = P
            while bits:
                bit = bits & -bits
                v = bit.bit_length() - 1
                bits -= bit
                degree = (graph[v] & P).bit_count()
                if degree < min_degree:
                    min_degree = degree
                    x = v
                if min_degree == 0:
                    break

            xbit = 1 << x
            if min_degree == 0:
                P &= ~xbit
                depth += 1
                picked |= xbit
            elif min_degree == 1:
                neighbor = (graph[x] & P) & -(graph[x] & P)
                P &= ~(xbit | neighbor)
                depth += 1
                picked |= xbit
            elif min_degree == 2:
                neighbors = graph[x] & P
                b1 = neighbors & -neighbors
                b2 = (neighbors ^ b1) & -(neighbors ^ b1)
                u = b1.bit_length() - 1
                w = b2.bit_length() - 1

                if graph[u] & b2:  # triangle
                    P &= ~(xbit | b1 | b2)
                    depth += 1
                    picked |= xbit
                else:  # fold the degree-two vertex and its neighbors
                    triple = xbit | b1 | b2
                    remaining = P & ~triple
                    external = (graph[u] | graph[w]) & remaining
                    y = len(graph)
                    ybit = 1 << y
                    graph2 = graph.copy()
                    graph2.append(external)

                    bits = remaining
                    while bits:
                        bit = bits & -bits
                        z = bit.bit_length() - 1
                        bits -= bit
                        graph2[z] = (graph2[z] & ~triple) | (
                            ybit if external & bit else 0
                        )

                    P = remaining | ybit
                    depth += 1
                    graph = graph2
                    history = history + [(y, u, w, x)]
            else:
                break

        # The partial transformed solution maps to a valid original one.
        if depth > best:
            best = depth
            bestmask = expand_folds(picked, history)

        if not P or depth + clique_cover_bound(P, graph) <= best:
            return

        # Branch on a maximum-degree remaining vertex.
        x = -1
        max_degree = -1
        bits = P
        while bits:
            bit = bits & -bits
            v = bit.bit_length() - 1
            bits -= bit
            degree = (graph[v] & P).bit_count()
            if degree > max_degree:
                max_degree = degree
                x = v

        xbit = 1 << x
        search(P & ~(graph[x] | xbit), depth + 1,
               picked | xbit, graph, history)
        if timed_out:
            return
        search(P & ~xbit, depth, picked, graph, history)

    search(full, 0, 0, adj, [])
    return [i for i in range(n) if not ((bestmask >> i) & 1)]
